summary: Completed comprehensive e2e testing of Text2trade v1.1 with API hardening features. All core features working: JWT auth flow, strategy CRUD, rate limiting, input sanitization, circuit breakers, backtest (simulated for RSI/MACD, yfinance for SMA/EMA), and Stochastic indicator UI in both entry/exit conditions.
passed_tests: Backend /api/v1/health returns healthy status with circuit breaker states (ai:closed, mongodb:closed, datasource:closed)
Backend /api/v1/analytics returns user count and strategy stats
Auth: User registration with valid password (min 8 chars, 1 number, 1 special char)
Auth: Password validation rejects weak passwords and missing special characters
Auth: Login returns access_token and refresh_token JWT tokens
Auth: Invalid credentials return 401
JWT: Protected endpoints require Authorization header with Bearer token
JWT: Strategies endpoint works with valid JWT
Strategy CRUD: Create strategy with JWT auth
Strategy CRUD: GET strategy verifies persistence in MongoDB
Strategy CRUD: DELETE strategy removes it (verified with 404 on GET)
Backtest: RSI strategy uses simulated backtest (data_source: simulated)
Backtest: SMA/EMA strategy uses yfinance historical data when available
Input Sanitization: Prompt injection patterns are filtered before AI endpoints
Rate Limiting: Registration endpoint rate limited at 5/minute (returns 429)
Frontend: Login page loads with Sign In / Sign Up tabs
Frontend: Login redirects to dashboard with JWT tokens stored in localStorage
Frontend: Dashboard sidebar shows user email and navigation
Frontend: Strategy Builder opens from 'Create Blank' card
Frontend: Stochastic indicator shows %K Period and %D Period fields in entry conditions
Frontend: Stochastic indicator shows %K Period and %D Period fields in exit conditions (FIX VERIFIED)
Frontend: Value field shows for both RSI and Stochastic indicators
Frontend: My Strategies page displays strategy cards with Backtest/Risk/Ask AI buttons
Frontend: Backtest button shows results panel with Trades, Win Rate, P&L, W/L stats
Frontend: Risk button shows AI-generated risk warnings panel
